title: Listen on a practice port
summary: Listen selects the address and port where Apache accepts connections. Bind a local experiment to loopback.
introduction: Listen selects the address and port where Apache accepts connections. Bind a local experiment to loopback. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain listen on a practice port
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Listen selects the address and port where Apache accepts connections. Bind a local experiment to loopback.
The practice server accepts connections on localhost port 8080 when started with a valid full configuration.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Identify which number is the port.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not bind a learning server to every network interface without understanding the exposure.
For more detail later, use this [Apache HTTP Server further reading](https://httpd.apache.org/docs/2.4/getting-started.html).
